summary: Fast Track Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Ms. Low Jiayi as Chief Operating Officer and director, effective September 2, 2026. The resignation was for personal reasons with no disagreement with management or the board. The company has begun a search for a replacement COO and director. The filing is routine in nature, but the abrupt departure of a senior officer and director constitutes a management change. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are involved; watch for announcements regarding the successor and any potential strategic impact.
